instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, eye-level full shot. On a wooden pier with a large suspension bridge under an overcast sky, the bearded man in a white t-shirt and black leggings (R2) and the woman with a shaved head in a white crop top and gray shorts (R1) stand side-by-side. The bearded man (R2) balances on his left leg on a pink mat, while the woman with a shaved head (R1) balances on her right leg on a beige mat. Both have their opposite foot tucked against their thigh and arms outstretched horizontally in a matching yoga pose, looking forward with calm expressions. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene with a muted color palette.
